mapper.select: SELECT C.BUYER ,C.USER_ID ,C.VERIF_NUM ,MAX(A.DESCRIPTION_LOC) AS DESCRIPTION ,(COUNT(C.BUYER_ITEM_NO)-1) AS ORDER_QTY ,MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = C.BUYER AND TYPE ='M014' AND CODE = C.REF_PR_NO)) AS REF_PR_TEXT ,MAX((CASE WHEN C.HI_DEPT_CODE IS NULL THEN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = C.BUYER AND TYPE ='C001' AND CODE = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = C.USER_ID)) ELSE (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = C.BUYER AND TYPE ='C001' AND CODE = C.HI_DEPT_CODE) END)) AS DEPT ,SUM((DECODE(C.CART_QTY,'0','1',NVL(C.CART_QTY,1)) * DECODE(A.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG,'N',NVL(C.UNIT_PRICE,0),NVL(B.TARGET_PRICE,0)))) AS TOT_SUM ,MAX(C.HI_DEPT_CODE) AS HI_DEPT_CODE ,MAX(C.REF_PR_NO) AS REF_PR_NO FROM ICOMBYIT A, ICOMCQDT B, ICOMCART C WHERE C.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND C.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = A.BUYER AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND B.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND C.VERIF_NUM IS NOT NULL AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','Y') AND C.USE_FLAG = 'C' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY C.BUYER , C.USER_ID, C.VERIF_NUM ORDER BY 3
